decisions: Choose the Snapshot + living docs governance policy.

Choose these Rust rules from now on: check formatting with `cargo fmt --all --check`; check linting with `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`; follow standard Rust item naming; return recoverable library errors instead of panicking; add no unsafe code; document public APIs. Keep structurally valid Cargo commands in AGENTS.md even if Cargo is unavailable on the current machine; report them as not run rather than creating repository migration work.
